instructions.intake.pointer: agent-governance-suite intake guide: skip rereading only while the current context retains both evidence of a successful read of the common intake and selection criteria in {path} and that text. Otherwise, including after either is lost to compaction, read that section before task work and follow it. Failed reads, partial output, or another revision do not count as a successful read.
instructions.intake.skills:
Skills are split by purpose. For every user message, before answering or using the next tool, match the judgment or action that message calls for against each skill's targets below, and call every matching skill now, before that judgment or action (questions and check requests included). Choose by whether the judgment you will actually make falls under the targets, not by names or keywords. A skill called earlier applies only to the judgment or action it was called for; do not apply an earlier skill's guidance that does not fit this purpose. When some work can be completed and verified on its own, consider delegating it to a subagent before doing it yourself. When delegating, write the goal, scope, forbidden areas, write ownership, the chosen skills and the completion and verification criteria in the brief, and do not hand off waiting such as watching for a result or polling progress.
{targets}
instructions.sessionMessage.guide: After a message send: autoWake available, no extra wake; no-live-relay/unsupported, wake once by host only if needed now, then tell the user the confirmed delivery state and that AGS auto-wake is unavailable. wake-unanswered (available): handed-off wake not yet answered. Report only confirmed queueing/delivery; autoWake alone proves no wake or delivery. Bodiless wakes/messages never stop work; never guess unreceived bodies.
